en: Sepia-toned landscape view over a historic town in a valley framed by lush vegetation in the foreground (palms, flowering shrubs and trees) with snow‑covered Alpine mountains in the background. A tall church tower with a pointed spire dominates the center of the town, and to the right on a hillside stands a rectangular medieval tower or castle keep. The image has a white border with slightly scalloped edges, typical of vintage postcards.
